title: Ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cone' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e8a24a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b8722a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='scoop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffc6e0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f78fb8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='scoop2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff3a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f5c94a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- cone body -->
  <path d='M36 55 L64 55 L50 92 Z' fill='url(#cone)'/>
  <!-- waffle grid on cone -->
  <path d='M40 62 L60 62 M43 71 L57 71 M46 80 L54 80' stroke='#f7d59a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 55 L48 74 M50 55 L50 78 M58 55 L52 74' stroke='#f7d59a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rim of cone -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#f0b060'/>
  <!-- bottom scoop (yellow) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='15' fill='url(#scoop2)'/>
  <path d='M38 44 Q44 38 50 42 Q56 36 62 43 Q64 50 56 52 Q50 47 44 53 Q37 51 38 44 Z' fill='#fff7c4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- top scoop (pink) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='13' fill='url(#scoop)'/>
  <path d='M40 28 Q45 22 50 26 Q55 21 60 27 Q62 33 56 34 Q50 30 45 35 Q39 34 40 28 Z' fill='#ffd9ea' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='4.5' fill='#e63b4a'/>
  <path d='M50 13 Q52 9 56 8' stroke='#7ad06a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='48.6' cy='15.8' r='1.3' fill='#ff9aa4'/>
  <!-- sprinkle dots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='28' r='1.3' fill='#7ad06a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='1.3' fill='#6ab8f0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='1.3' fill='#e63b4a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='1.3' fill='#6ab8f0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='45' r='1.3' fill='#7ad06a'/>
</svg>
